items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: Massive numbers in Week 10 romp
items.text:
Gibbs carried the ball 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of eight targets for 99 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots.

items.title: Jared Goff: Tosses three TDs in Munich
items.text:
Goff completed 20 of 31 passes for 303 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich. He added three yards on his only carry.
